title: A DEAD CRIER LEAVES WRECKAGE, NOT A BOX
why: His note: it would be cool if it showed wreckage instead, same for other enemy deaths. A dead Crier left the generic brown wreck. It now leaves the drone crashed on the ground: the pod cracked on its bent X frame with four dead rotor hubs and still blades, the lamp black, the loudspeaker horn broken off with its ochre ring. Smoke while unsearched. Looting is unchanged.
now: A dead Crier lies crashed and smoking.
